messages:
Olivia (Partnerships): Quick shoutout  CascadeCare (homecare SaaS) renewed via the AWS Marketplace and expanded their reserved capacity. They also signed off to be our Q2 case study! :sparkles:
Raj (Sales): Great news! Its a 15-month renewal with a 30% uplift in committed capacity. Upsell came from demonstrating latency wins during the POC.
Mei (Solutions Eng): Rolled their optimized bundle (quantized + custom tokenizer fixes). Addressed the token mismatch that affected address parsing. p50 generation for their short templates is ~85ms now.
Connor (Infra): Deployed the new warm-pool + sticky-session tweak for their tenancy. Cold-start p95 improved from ~1.0s to ~240ms. Added a soft throttle for their spike-prone batch jobs.
CaseBot: deploy/redwood-dedicated/cascadecare -> prod succeeded (job id: d-99002) \u2705
Raj (Sales): Customer quote for marketing: "Redwood cut our inference spend and gave us predictable latency for on-call caregivers." Need a one-sentence approval from legal/marketing before public.
Mei (Solutions Eng): For the case study technical appendix, I'll add the kernel config and a tiny repro snippet. Paste for reference:
```
# quick repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-qv1","input":"Check caregiver schedule for 7/12"}'
```
Connor (Infra): Also added canary policy: 7% -> quantized variant, auto-fallback to float if errorRate > 0.6%. Dashboards: /dashboards/cascadecare-dedicated.
Olivia (Partnerships): Outcomes summary we can share internally: ~2.6x cost vs. customers self-host baseline, median response ~95ms, and immediate plan to roll Redwood to 3 more product teams. Raj - can you and marketing drop the approved quote and assets to the partner drive?
Raj (Sales): Will do. Ill ping legal and drop the signed quote + logo in the drive by EOD.
Mei (Solutions Eng): I'll upload a 2-paragraph technical blurb to #eng-runtime and attach perf graphs.
Olivia (Partnerships): Amazing work everyone 389. Tagging for visibility: @here :tada:
